newsitem.title: UK: Greenwich and Portman building societies to merge.
newsitem.headline: Greenwich and Portman building societies to merge.

text.p: The Portman and Greenwich Building Societies said on Monday that they are to merge this summer and will have combined assets in excess of 4.3 billion pounds ($7 billion).
Greenwich, Britain's 46th largest building society, said in a joint statement that its shareholders will vote on the merger on June 17 and that the intended merger date is July 30.
Existing Greenwich investors and borrowers will be eligible to receive a bonus as part of the deal.

Qualifying investors will be entitled to a bonus of five percent gross on the balance of their account up to a maximum of 2,500 pounds, while qualifying borrowers will be entitled to a bonus of 200 pounds for each mortgaged property.
Portman said that after the planned building society conversions it will become the UK's sixth largest building society. It is currently the 10th largest with assets in excess of four billion pounds.
